_note: Power-local numbers (F1, revision PWR-R1 on params A1-R3, 2026-11-09). Namespaced under 'power.' so proofkit can read them as P:power.<key> without clashing with params.json. Shared numbers (pod base, board thickness, pack size, pack mass, allocation) come from redesign/params/params.json; pod stations (plate, bosses, channels, park zone, aft stop) are read read-only from subsystems/pod/params.json so the power parts sit on the pod as D2 built it. Read by subsystems/power/fusion/power.py and subsystems/power/power_claims.py. Metres unless stated. Bought-part envelopes are EST until measured on arrival (T-PWR-ARRIVAL).

as150u_half_m.source: team/F1/POWER.md (mated pair 55 x 22 x 14 mm EST)
as150u_half_m.note: one AS150U half, L (x, mating axis) x W (y, the two contacts side by side) x H (z); mated length 2 x 0.029 - overlap; measure on arrival

as150u_contact_pitch_m.note: centre distance of the two main contacts (y)

as150u_mass_g.note: aircraft half with heat-shrink; the pack half is inside the pack mass

board_env_m.source: CoreWing F405 Wing V2 manual V2.1 p. 13 (PDB 52 x 32 mm incl. battery pads); height 9 mm = split-case allowance (BOARD-CHECK.md step 3)
board_env_m.note: power board (PWR-003, the PDB alone, case S) as drawn: L x W x H incl. pads and components; aft edge (pads) at the deck window, so it sits in the aft 52 mm of KO-PWR-BOARD and leaves 4 mm forward. Height and outline measured at BOARD-CHECK.md step 3 (D-74)

ko_board_m.note: power-board keep-out on the deck: x range (56 mm = 52 board + 2 + 2), width centred on the board centreline (34 mm), top z. Fits the board split (case S) or the whole FC stack (case U); the deck is drawn to its footprint (CL-PWR-KO-FIT, CL-PWR-KO-TOP)

stack_u_h_m.source: power SPEC.md KO-PWR-BOARD case U: 5 mm gel cubes + 17 mm stack (manual) + 2 mm strap and sway
stack_u_h_m.note: height above the deck top of the whole-stack fallback (case U); measured at BOARD-CHECK.md step 3

board_mass_g.source: subsystems/avionics/params.json#fc_mass_g note (F3: 40 g stack - 12 g FC = ~28 g)

deck_t_m.note: PETG frame plate (deck + cradle floor), 100 % infill

deck_margin_m.note: deck edge beyond the power board on each long side (34 mm = KO-PWR-BOARD width); in x the deck runs from the keep-out's forward end to the cradle

window_x_m.note: wire window through the deck between the power board aft edge and the cradle front wall: the 10 AWG output pair drops through it to the bus bars

spacer_h_m.note: nylon spacer under each deck corner (OD 6 / ID 3.2): lifts the deck clear of the bus board, its bars and the 16 AWG joints (>= 7 mm)

cradle_wall_h_m.note: side walls up the AS150U housing (housing 14 mm)

cradle_bond_mm2.source: fusion/power.py cradle: floor 29 x 22 + side walls 2 x 29 x 10 + front wall 22 x 10 (rounded down)
cradle_bond_mm2.note: aircraft-half housing sanded 120 grit, 30 min epoxy into the cradle; one tie through two floor slots over it (secondary)

unplug_force_n.note: measure with a luggage scale on arrival (T-PWR-ARRIVAL)

bond_tau_pa.note: lap shear of 30 min epoxy on sanded nylon housing, low-end class value (coupon at T-PWR-ARRIVAL)

leg_m.note: two legs under the cradle's aft end down to the pod floor (x, y section); leave a lead tunnel under the cradle

leg_setback_m.note: cradle legs set 10 mm forward of the cradle's aft end (x 0.046-0.050, still under the cradle floor), so the left ESC pairs turn from their XT30U to the side exit behind them (F2 ROUTE-CLEARANCE.md)

bus_board_m.note: PWR-004 carrier: FR4 1.6 mm, 1 oz copper one side, cut with a shear; isolation slot 2 mm filed along x; fits the 17.9 mm strip between D2's boss rows

bar_m.source: 8 AWG solid-equivalent diameter 3.26 mm (ASTM B258); length 35 mm (was 25) per params/CHANGE-LOG.md#D-87: four ESC pairs at 8 mm stations + the main jumper landing, on the 36 mm FR4 carrier
bar_m.note: two bus bars of stripped 8 AWG strand, tinned solid and soldered along each rail: length, diameter, centre pitch (y)

bus_mass_g.source: CALC-PWR-PARTS (FR4 1.2 g + bars 3.7 g x 35/25 = 5.2 g + solder 2.0 g + tape 0.4 g; D-87 bars 35 mm, EST)

cap_m.source: EST, 680 uF 25 V low-ESR radial 10 x 20 mm

cap_gap_x_m.note: cap starts this far aft of the ESC pad's aft end (power end), leads <= 20 mm (CR-F1-07)

frame_mass_g.source: CALC-PWR-PARTS: PETG frame ~7.0 g from CAD volume (D-74: deck 42 -> 56 mm +1.1 g, fuse clip deleted -0.4 g) + 4 nylon M3x18 + 4 spacers + 4 washers 1.6 g + 1 tie 0.3 g + tape 0.8 g (EST)

jumper_awg.note: main jumpers AS150U -> power board -> bus bars: <= 0.05 m each, so conduction to the terminals sets their temperature; 10 AWG replaces the 0.15 m 8 AWG run of team/F1/POWER.md

jumper_len_m.note: per conductor: W-MAIN-1 cups -> power board input, W-MAIN-2 power board output -> bus bars (down through the deck window)

jumper_drop_m.source: fusion/power.py layout: power board top 0.0488 - bus bar centre 0.0240

wire_10awg.source: ASM-F1-WIRE-OD (OD); IEC 60228 class-5 resistance 20 degC; silicone wire listing class mass
wire_10awg.note: OD, resistance per metre at 20 degC, mass per metre (one conductor)

bend_k.note: minimum inside bend radius / OD for fixed, never-flexed fine-strand silicone jumpers

i_cont_a.note: copy for the CAD-free geometry calcs; the claims read CL-F1-I-CONT directly

screw.note: E-PWR-03: M3x18 nylon pan head + nylon washer, through the deck and a 10 mm nylon spacer, into the M3 x 5.7 brass insert in the D2 boss
